finding: Exact feed-merge equality rejects a legitimate collector descendant; Pages workflow success can also conceal a skipped deploy job.
required_repair: Retain exact merged PR head green checks.
Require actual Pages deploy job success.
Require deployed head identical to or descended from original feed merge, with merge base bound to that merge.
Require nonempty exact deployed-head completed green checks and successful aggregate guards.
Verify remote committed feed blob SHA and size at original feed PR head and deployment head; require identical bytes.
Require canonical current-edition entry equals the committed entry.
Retain reviewed master and mobile hashes, canonical phone playback advancement, Gmail draft body and routing.
Retain original feed merge and actual deployed descendant separately in receipt.
negative_cases: Stale workflow success with skipped deployment
Missing, incomplete or failing exact-head checks
Changed committed feed bytes or live entry
